integrity: The coefficientwise determinant inequalities are checked exactly for every one of the 16215 symmetry-anchored vertex quadruples by embedded dependency-free CHECK.py; the vertex-reduction, nonvertex-uniqueness and ratio-minimization proofs are mathematical arguments, not machine-certification claims.
limitations: The exact law applies to the specified one-parameter type-B3 signed-permutahedral family for q>0, not to arbitrary signed permutahedra or q=0 optimizer counts. Unindexed historical tables could independently contain the result. No independent validation has occurred.
title: Sharp tetrahedral volume and optimizer partition in cubic signed permutahedra
